name: the configured servers are reported with their health
description: GET /api/db/servers is the cluster's shape as PhabricatorGorgeDBClient reads it: one record per configured node, each carrying its static topology (refKey, host, port, isMaster, isDefaultPartition) and the result of a live probe (connectionStatus, replicaStatus). It never fails on a dead node — an unreachable server is reported in-band with connectionStatus 'fail' — so the array is the whole answer and there is no error branch to parse. The seeded cluster is one healthy master at db1:3306, so its connectionStatus is 'okay'.
